_about: Lens build spec. t = mm forward of the mount flange. 'profile' = radius curve from the official side photo (tools/lens_profile.py -> lens_profiles/<id>.json). Bands: metal = trim, body = fixed barrel, zoom = ribbed rubber zoom ring, focus = knurled focus/control ring, inner = barrel that slides forward when zooming. prints: [text, t, angle_deg (90 = top, at the mount index), cap height mm]. scale: focal-length numbers on the zoom ring with angle offsets from the index, measured in the photo. Dimensions from <spec URL> on <YYYY-MM-DD>.
